store_title: dune-atlas Mars cell store: MACDA v2.0 reanalysis (Mars Year 30) two-hourly lowest-level winds, air state and sand-flux fields at 64 grain sizes
series_note: u, v = uwind, vwind of the lowest sigma level s = 0.9995 (the wind at that sample's height z); T = temp of that level; rho = p/(R T) with p = s ps; z = (R T/g) ln(1/s); float32 with mantissas rounded to series_keepbits (|error| <= 0.005 m/s, 0.02 K, 0.05 % rho, 1 mm z). Fields are computed from the unrounded values.
ls_definition: MACDA model solar longitude Ls (deg; 0 at time 0, the start of MY24; not the astronomical Ls); Mars Year 30 = every step with MACDA MY_Ls = 30, Ls 0.034 to 359.983
sol_definition: MACDA time (sols since the start of MY24; the fraction of a sol is the mean solar time of day at the prime meridian), one sample every two Mars hours, 4011.667 to 4680.167 in Mars Year 30
pyramid_source: Fields computed for the Mars dune atlas from the MACDA v2.0 reanalysis (Valeanu et al. 2026, CEDA, doi:10.5285/cd037a9ea387438fabf4d674dbe53088; read from ARCO-MACDA, doi:10.57967/hf/8771), Mars Year 30 two-hourly lowest-level winds, temperature and air density, with the per-hour threshold and transport rate of Pähtz & Durán (2023) J. Fluid Mech. 963, A20, doi:10.1017/jfm.2023.343, and the crest-mode methods outlined in Gunn, A. (2026) The distribution of Earth's wind-blown sand dunes. Nature Communications. doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75466-y
qsdiv_grid_text: on the MACDA 5° grid (periodic in longitude, one-sided at the ±87.5° rows)
rho_description: Mean over the two-hourly samples of Mars Year 30 of the lowest-level air density rho_f = p/(R T) (p = s ps at the lowest sigma level s = 0.9995, T = temp of that level, R = 191.8 J kg-1 K-1).
fields_method: 23 sand-flux fields at 64 median grain diameters from the lowest-level winds, time-averaged over Mars Year 30 (one sample every two Mars hours), per-sample threshold and flux (Pähtz & Durán 2023) with the crest-mode methods outlined in Gunn (2026) Nat Commun doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75466-y
